_comment: SEEDS for regions.json (scripts/measure-vehicle.mjs --place-regions). A seed is a STRUCTURAL identification — 'this pixel lies inside that material's area' — never a measurement: the placer grows the seed's same-colour component and keeps the largest square window inside it that is uniform (every px within `uniform` of the seed colour), nearest the seed; the zone median is recomputed from the pixels every run. role = the vehicle-class role whose id-pass mask the zone is compared against; face marks the two flat body tones (front = the +X flank, side = the +Z nose). Every flat colour of the target gets one zone; materials that share a colour share a zone (the bus's black: bumpers, window band, pillars, mirrors, stop-arm post, marker pods are one paint, the tyres a second black).

body_side.note: the +X flank below the window band

body_front.note: the +Z nose face between the headlights

roof.note: the roof and the front cap above the windshield (lit, paler than the flank)

glass.note: windshield pane and a side pane

tyre.note: the rear tyre's face ahead of and below its hub

black.note: the black paint: front and rear bumpers (also the band, pillars, mirrors, stop-arm post, pods)

amber.note: the amber turn lamps under the headlights (the amber marker lenses read the same)

signal.note: the stop-sign face and the red marker lenses

orange.note: the amber (orange) roof-marker lenses inboard of the red ones
